maya: quick heads-up — our EU aggregate hours for 'active_sessions' show a drop for 2026-03-10 00:00-08:00, looks like late-ingest. spike in late events in kafka topic. I'm seeing ~120k missing counts vs expected.
ben: pinging ingest team, can you share sample IDs? any backfill in-flight?
carla: not aware of any scheduled replays. which partition? topic-eu-agg-6?
maya: partition 12.. I ran a quick query:
```
select hour, sum(counts) from agg_active_sessions where hour >= '2026-03-10' and region='eu' group by hour
```
result shows hour 01-06 ~ 0
ben: ok. can we do a targeted recompute for 00-08 only? full recompute is expensive. estimate ~30k token-hours.
dan: +1 for targeted, but need to ensure dedupe. last time we had dupes with naive replay. add idempotency on upsert.
carla: suggested plan:
- lock hour ranges 00-08
- run replayer with dedupe_mode=idempotent
- route to priority-lane queue so it doesn't kill prod slots
- monitor aggregate delta and replay errors
maya: sounds good. What about quota? we only have 2 priority slots free this weekend.
ben: can we temporarily bump priority for this run via console? manual override +1 slot for 6h
carla: I can file the console override. Will add quota tag `recompute:eu-targeted` and set `quota_lease=6h`.
replay-bot: scheduled replay job created: job_id=rj_20260310_eu_01-08 by carla. ETA start 2026-03-13 02:00 UTC.
maya: thanks. monitoring queries I'll watch:
```
-- pre-check
select count(*) from raw_events where ingest_ts between '2026-03-10T00:00:00Z' and '2026-03-10T08:00:00Z' and processed=false;
-- post-check
select hour, sum(counts) from agg_active_sessions where hour between ...;
```
dan: add a sanity check to fail the job if delta > 10% to avoid runaway recompute costs.
ben: also surface the cost estimate in console run dialog (UX issue filed: #PRJ-475). keep run notes minimal.
maya: noted. I'll be on-call for the run. ping me if job enters error state.
carla: will post final run summary here after completion. :thumbsup:
